newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Police charge man with child abuse after report.
newsitem.headline: Police charge man with child abuse after report.

text.p: Cyprus police on Monday charged a man with sexually abusing a six-year-old girl but only after her sobbing mother appeared on television to criticise the authorities for not acting sooner.

Cypriot authorities sprang into action on Monday by charging the 47-year-old real estate agent from the southern coastal town of Limassol for the sexual abuse of a minor. The first hearing into the case is on Wednesday, a police spokesman said.
"There were unjustified delays in investigating this case and we want to know who is responsible," police spokesman Glafcos Xenos told Reuters, referring to the divisional police command in Limassol.

The case was reported to police in April by the child's parents. After an initial remand of six days the suspect was released without explanation and the child's family were being kept in the dark over the course of inquiries, her mother told the private Antenna TV station on Friday night.
Reports of child abuse are extremely rare in Cyprus.
